title: EnterpriseRAG-Bench pilot: GPT-OSS-120B systems
purpose: Score GPT-OSS no RAG, GPT-OSS + LangChain vector RAG, GPT-OSS + Microsoft GraphRAG (fast method, local search) and 4Minds (Constellations) on 50 stratified questions and a 10,000-document corpus slice with the official metrics-based evaluation (default settings, gpt-5.4 judge); write the results in the leaderboard file format; estimate a full run.
